A.notes: A has a coherent stage-light poster mood and it delivers the date and ticket price immediately, but the idea weakens once the page turns into a generic card grid and ticket form. Typography is strong and the build is clean on desktop and mobile, yet the motion shown in the scroll strip is fairly modest and the brief's accessible schedule is not really solved.

B.notes: B has the stronger central idea: 'Two days. Two stages. One city.' drives the type, color system, sectioning and scroll sequence in a memorable way. The scroll-strip motion clearly progresses and supports the story, but the mobile/full-page captures show large empty areas and awkward horizontal card behavior, so craft drops sharply despite a solid reduced-motion fallback.

raw.why: B is the more distinctive and fully authored concept, with motion and typography that create a stronger festival signature even though A is cleaner on mobile.
